decisions.content: skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md: rules 1-10, When to break the rules 1/4/5/6, Pre-send check; README.md: what it does and no-diagnosis framing
decisions.reason: Breadth: clear, complete and actionable communication is useful across Marionette's design, Office, engineering and research sessions, including ordinary answers before a capability is selected. Timing: response framing applies from the first reply. Fit: it governs conversational presentation, not a new output producer or routing authority. Adapt the source's own task/harness exceptions into flexible guidance that honors user expertise, requested depth, uncertainty and authorized autonomy. Merge with Ponytail's complementary collaboration policy; no parallel skill. This standalone candidate is 1283 characters per native session, makes no additional model call, writes no user file and adds no source hook; the combined policy must stay at most 2000 characters.

decisions.content: SKILL.md diagnostic opening and What ADHD changes about reading; absolute every-turn action/progress/numbering, five-item/two-minute limits, compelled estimates and exact stop phrases
decisions.reason: Authority: the requested adaptation must respect the person and current context, not diagnose the user or impose a rigid form. The source itself says completeness, explanation requests, the task and the harness win (When to break the rules; rule 9; Pre-send check). Keep useful communication goals, omit unsupported identity/cognitive claims and fixed numeric constraints. Honor ordinary user style changes semantically; do not add a Python phrase detector. Do not invent a cause or a time estimate merely to fill a template.

decisions.content: hooks/hooks.json; hooks/always-on.{mjs,sh,ps1}; .opencode/plugins/i-have-adhd.{mjs,js}; extensions/{i-have-adhd,context-compat}.ts; source mode flags, persisted state and status
decisions.reason: Function: these mechanisms inject the same policy or toggle its source-specific mode; none performs separate user work. Original defaults are manual/flag-gated, with saved Pi session state and opt-in CLI/config. The inspected Claude hook reads a flag and prints policy at startup/resume/clear/compact; OpenCode adds config/skill/command registrations and per-turn system text; Pi/OMP registers commands/input/session handlers, stores mode entries and displays status. They would duplicate native delivery and introduce Node/Pi dependencies and competing activation/state. The factory native policy channel supplies the synthesized guidance, so no source executable/hook is copied, registered or run.

decisions.reason: The manifests, slash commands, global-instruction edits and install/uninstall recipes package or activate the original source itself. They do not add a communication outcome beyond the canonical skill. Dropping competing routing and source installation follows the intake contract. Add i-have-adhd to plugin.replaces; Marionette's generated adapters own discovery and native policy. Cursor's SKILL.md has the exact canonical blob SHA. No separate review-response capability is inferred from the Codex default prompt.

decisions.content: scripts/*; evals/*; tests/*; .github/workflows/*; AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md; translated docs and branding
decisions.reason: These are source development, QA, CI, installation translations and branding, not end-user skill procedures. Static audit inspected all runtime/developer helper files and eval protocol/rubric/results/cases, with uninspected test bodies and translations explicitly recorded. Eval runners call paid host CLIs and write JSONL; Pi smoke script installs the source into a temporary configuration; CI may install tools/run models. None is executed or adopted. The reported upstream candidate gate failure is a caution to preserve uncertainty, not evidence this adaptation passed behavioral testing.

always_on: Communicate so the user can understand and act without reconstructing context. Lead with the answer or result; give a next action when user action is needed. Adapt depth and vocabulary to the user's demonstrated knowledge, current constraints and requested format. Explain unfamiliar or complex ideas completely, using concrete examples or diagrams when they help; do not re-teach settled context. Use short paragraphs or bounded numbered steps when useful, never a fixed response template. Group long material without omitting required details, alternatives, uncertainty or verification evidence. During work expose the useful state change, blocker or decision; show concrete results. Perform authorized agent-owned work without needless confirmations or assigning it back to the user. Ask only a material question that the available evidence cannot resolve. Report failures neutrally, separating observed facts from possible causes; revisit the assumption after repeated failed fixes. Give time estimates only when useful and grounded, for whoever must do the work. Respect user requests to change the style. Preserve host instructions, permissions and each capability's deliverable and review requirements. End when complete; name one useful next action only if something remains.
